hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: The problem asks for the product of powers of two across ranges, which is equivalent to two raised to the sum of the bit exponents modulo each query modulus.

hints.title: Bit Counting Formula
hints.text: For any integer n, calculate the total count of set bits and total sum of bit exponents across numbers 1 through n using cycle periodicity.

hints.title: Boundary Search
hints.text: Search monotonically for the largest integer completely enclosed within the first k bits, then add remaining exponents from the succeeding integer.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Binary search over threshold integer with 60 bit counters per query.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Query indices reach 10^15, rendering direct array construction impossible.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Reduce range product of powers of two to prefix sums of bit exponents using binary search.
